limitations: The reference button fill and fast moves are themselves unvalidated.
Same-crop button calibration was inherited unchanged from the earlier official pilot.
Layout/boundary review exposed the videos; no state/timing parameters were fitted on them.
Both comparisons use --told, which supplies peer-inferred fast moves when available.
Metrics apply to eligible looks; animations and unreadable values reduce coverage.
View agreement does not verify exact HP, forms, stat stages or all game events.
Agent frame review identified combat by 4.517 seconds but a 20.7-second model origin in one view.
Forms are not verified: a displayed Ninetales still uses generic species defaults and guessed moves.
Many adjacent looks belong to the same match; denominators are looks, not independent battles.
Strict consistency checks use the published reconstruction; the separate --told comparison is diagnostic.
